instruction: Star exactly one email in the Bills folder

rules.sql: select count(*) = 1 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13);

metadata.explanation: Task requires starring exactly 1 email in Bills folder (folderID=13, contains 2 emails). The evaluator checks if exactly 1 message in folder 13 has star attribute. SQL returns 1 (true) if count equals 1. Verified from database: folder 13 is Bills with 2 emails.
